ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT This ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (at times referred to as the "Agreement"), made as of the ↓Z day of March, 2026, by and between 1538 HOE LLC, having an address at 1538 Hoe Avenue, Bronx, New York 10460 (referred to herein as “Parcel A Owner"), and MANFIELD VYSE AVE LLC, having an address at 15 Mangin Rd, Monroe, NY 10950 (referred to herein as“Parcel B Owner").Parcel A Owner and Parcel B Owner are sometimes WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Parcel A Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 1538 Hoe Avenue, Bronx, New York, and designated as Tax Lot 8 in Block 2989 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Bronx County (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively referred to as the “Parcel A Land,” said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein collectively referred to as the “Parcel A Building,” and the Parcel A Land and the Parcel A Building being herein collectively referred to as “"Parcel A"); WHEREAS, Parcel B Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, generally known as and street address 1537Vyse Avenue,Bronx,NewYork,and designated as Tax Lot 44 in Block 2989 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein collectively referred to as the "Parcel B Land,” said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein collectively referred to as the “Parcel B Building,” and the Parcel B Land, the Parcel B Building being herein collectivelyreferred to as"ParcelB"); WHEREAS, Parcel B Owner intends to construct the Parcel B Building on Parcel B with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Parcel B under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if Parcel B were to be considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Parcel A, if Parcel A were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot, that are in excess of the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), which are available for transfer pursuant to theZoningResolution;
